artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in the setting of computability theory on subsets of ω. Recall the following notions.

(i) A set A ⊆ ω is Δ⁰₂ if A ≤_T ∅' (equivalently, A has a computable approximation).
(ii) A set A is 1-generic if for every c.e. set W of finite binary strings, some initial segment of (the characteristic function of) A either lies in W or has no extension in W.
(iii) A set A is low if A' ≡_T ∅'.
(iv) A tower is a sequence (A_n)_{n∈ω} of infinite subsets of ω such that A_{n+1} ⊆* A_n (i.e. A_{n+1}\A_n is finite) for every n. A tower is maximal if there is no infinite B ⊆ ω with B ⊆* A_n for all n other than those almost equal to some A_n. A set X computes a maximal tower if there is a maximal tower (A_n) such that the function n ↦ A_n is computable from X (uniformly).
(v) A set A ⊆ ω is index guessable if there is an A-computable function g such that for every index e of a partial A-computable function φ_e^A which is total and {0,1}-valued, the function φ_{g(e)} is total computable and agrees with φ_e^A.

It is known that the following implications hold:
   1-generic Δ⁰₂   ⇒   index guessable   ⇒   computes no maximal tower   ⇒   low.

Determine whether the first implication is reversible (i.e., must every index guessable set be 1-generic Δ⁰₂?), and whether the second implication is reversible (i.e., must every set that computes no maximal tower be index guessable?).
artifact.status_search_result: The implication chain originates in work on maximal towers and ultrafilter bases in computability theory (J. Symbolic Logic, 2023). The reversibility of the first two implications is posed as an open problem in a 2025 compilation of open problems in computability and descriptive set theory; web searches reveal no published resolution as of May 2026.

status_evidence.title: Maximal towers and ultrafilter bases in computability theory
status_evidence.snippet: Every noncomputable (low) c.e. set computes a maximal tower but no 1-generic Δ⁰₂ set does so; index guessability is introduced and the implication chain is established.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the implication chain whose reversibility is asked.
